verticalDescription: Applied AI engineering: LLM apps, RAG, agents on AWS, evaluation and shipping AI systems to production.

courses.title: AI-Infusion: Applied AI from First API Call to Production
courses.description: Ten lessons from your first API call to designing, evaluating and building a production-shaped AI system: prompting, LangChain, RAG, Docker, agents on AWS, multi-agent systems and evaluation benches.

modules.title: Start Here: Course Map and Setup
modules.description: How the ten lessons fit together, and the one-time laptop setup: WSL, Python, models, API keys and a setup check.

modules.title: Lesson 1 · Build & Ship Your First AI App
modules.description: Tokens, training, the API call and your first AI summarizer, with interactive simulators.

modules.title: Lesson 2 · LangChain & Your First Agent
modules.description: Prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning, LangChain chains and memory, and a first tiny agent shipped as a shop assistant.

modules.title: Lessons 3–4 · RAG: Give Your AI a Library
modules.description: Embeddings, chunking, vector search, reranking and hybrid search, ending in a chat-with-your-PDFs project.

modules.title: Lesson 5 · Dockerize Everything
modules.description: Containers, images, Compose and shipping an AI app as a reproducible stack.

modules.title: Lesson 6 · AI Agents on AWS
modules.description: Building and deploying agents with AWS services.

modules.title: Lesson 7 · The Interview Coach
modules.description: A tool-using interview coach agent with memory, then a multi-agent interviewer.

modules.title: Lesson 8 · The Shipment Exception Desk
modules.description: An agentic exception-handling desk for logistics, run end to end.

modules.title: Lessons 9–10 · The Refund Bench
modules.description: Designing, evaluating and building a production-shaped refund decision system.

courses.title: Agentic AI on AWS Bootcamp
courses.description: Build AI agents on AWS with Strands, Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore, from a first agent to a team running in production, plus live finance and travel projects.

modules.title: Bootcamp Overview
modules.description: What the bootcamp covers, week by week, with recordings and projects.

modules.title: Week 1 · Part 00 · AWS Revision
modules.description: The AWS, LangChain and agent basics the bootcamp builds on.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 1 · Your First AI Agent
modules.description: From a model that only talks to an agent that thinks, uses tools and acts, built on Amazon Bedrock with Strands.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 2 · Giving Agents Tools
modules.description: Tool calling, built-in and custom tools, and the AWS tool.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 3 · Agents That Remember
modules.description: Short- and long-term memory, Mem0, AgentCore Memory and checkpointing.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 4 · Agents That Work Together
modules.description: Multi-agent patterns: orchestrators, swarms, graphs and workflows.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 5 · How Agents Talk
modules.description: MCP and A2A in depth: the wire protocol, tools, resources, prompts, roots and agent-to-agent tasks.

modules.title: Week 1 · Lesson 6 · Shipping Agents to Production
modules.description: Deploying agents on Lambda, ECS and AgentCore, with observability, security and resilience.

modules.title: Week 1 · Project 1 · AI Agents in Finance
modules.description: LLMs through a finance lens and agent design patterns, finance edition, with three labs.

modules.title: Week 1 · Project 2 · NPS Analyst in a Box
modules.description: An agent that turns customer survey responses into an NPS analysis a bank can act on.

modules.title: Week 2 · Project 1 · Trip Buddy
modules.description: A travel assistant built step by step: RAG, chains, a tool loop, an MCP server and Slack / WhatsApp delivery.
